mapper.update: UPDATE ck_shop_order_payment SET status = 'SUCCESS', channel_trade_no = #{channelTradeNo}, paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, pay_time = #{payTime}, error_code = NULL, error_msg = NULL, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('INIT', 'PENDING')

UPDATE ck_shop_order_payment SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, close_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CLOSED' THEN NOW() ELSE close_time END, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN #{st}

UPDATE ck_shop_order_payment SET refund_amount = refund_amount + #{delta}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND refund_amount + #{delta} <= amount
UPDATE ck_shop_order_payment SET refund_amount = refund_amount - #{delta}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND refund_amount >= #{delta}
UPDATE ck_shop_order_payment SET notify_count = notify_count + 1, notify_time = #{notifyTime}, last_notify_body = #{body}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ck_shop_order_payment WHERE status IN ('INIT', 'PENDING') AND del_flag = 0 AND create_time < #{createdBefore} ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
